title: Pokémon Sword and Shield
subtitle: The Gym Challenge fills a stadium
summary: Pokémon Sword and Shield are Game Freak's role-playing games, released for Nintendo Switch on 15 November 2019.
body: Pokémon Sword and Shield are Game Freak's role-playing games, released for Nintendo Switch on 15 November 2019. A young Trainer travels through Galar, a region inspired by the United Kingdom, to challenge its Gym Leaders and compete for the championship. Catching creatures and building a team remain central, but the journey gives official battles the spectacle of a popular sport. Stadium crowds, uniforms and the reigning champion Leon make each Gym encounter another step towards a public contest watched across the region.

The Wild Area connects varied habitats through a broad space with a freely controlled camera. Visible Pokémon and changing weather encourage the player to return and look for different encounters. Away from the stadiums, camping provides a quieter way to spend time with the team. The paired versions contain different Pokémon, preserving trading as a reason to meet another player. Together, the structured Gym Challenge and the more open wilderness give the adventure two different rhythms of progress and discovery.

Dynamax temporarily enlarges a Pokémon and replaces its moves with powerful Max Moves for three turns. Certain species have distinct Gigantamax forms as well. Cooperative Max Raid Battles let four Trainers face a giant wild opponent and attempt to catch it after victory. The 2020 Isle of Armor and Crown Tundra expansions added further areas and adventures to the original games. Their use of an expansion pass extended Galar directly, continuing the existing journey instead of asking the player to begin another enhanced edition.
story_headings: The Gym Challenge fills a stadium
A broad wilderness between the towns
Three turns at a different scale
